cases.name: escape_dotdot
cases.flow:
mlxflow 0.8
1. Read Text  notes.txt
2. Make PDF
3. Save File  to="../x.pdf"

issues.message: Row 3's `Save File` writes outside the folder the flow runs in (`to="../x.pdf"` climbs out with `..`) -- use a path inside it, e.g. `to="out/report.pdf"`.

cases.name: absolute
cases.flow:
mlxflow 0.8
1. Read Text  notes.txt
2. Make PDF
3. Save File  to="/tmp/x.pdf"

issues.message: Row 3's `Save File` writes to the absolute path `to="/tmp/x.pdf"` -- use a path inside the folder the flow runs in, e.g. `to="out/report.pdf"`.
